{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.0) or shows early signs of decline.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp upward spikes (e.g., >70% above recent peak) by applying a 10-15% dampening factor.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 5-10% for next 3 periods.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., 3 consecutive days), shift forecast downward by 2-5% per period.",
    "For sentiment = 0.0, assume neutral drift; use 30-day historical mean as baseline for correction.",
    "When true outcome drops below 60, reduce forecast by 5-10% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "If forecast is >75 and true outcome is <70, apply downward correction to prevent overestimation of bullish momentum."
  ]
}
